description: Add content items to the end of a distribution queue. Items publish in the queue's next available time slots, so adding them schedules content for publishing. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

captionOverride.description: Optional custom caption to override content default

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_add_queue_items
title: Add Queue Items
